summary: End-to-end testing of MediMind backend (25 pytest cases) and frontend (Playwright covering Dashboard, Assistant, Documents, Imaging, Review, Workflow, Analytics, Settings). Everything passed. Backend covers health/config, chat pipeline (Medical RAG, low-confidence handoff to Web Search, emergency guardrail, web-research keyword routing), document CRUD (seed check, PDF upload, doc-query, demo-delete-refused, user-delete OK), web search, imaging for all 3 modalities, clinician reviews (approve/reject/second-review + persistence via re-GET + audit trail), analytics, conversations, dashboard, and voice TTS. Frontend flows exercised all critical data-testid interactions with real backend, including review approve persistence across reload.

issues: React Flow warning: nodeTypes/edgeTypes created inside component; should be memoized or module-level to avoid re-creation warnings (non-blocking).

action_items: (Optional) Move React Flow nodeTypes/edgeTypes out of Workflow.jsx component body or wrap in useMemo to remove console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes many resources in one file (~545 lines) — acceptable but nearing the 700-line split threshold; consider modularising per resource for future growth.

In server.py _handle_imaging, image is stored as base64 data URL inside MongoDB documents; for larger images this bloats DB and API responses. Consider GridFS or object storage when the demo is upgraded.
web_search demo fallback is intentional per spec; ensure production toggle documented (Settings already surfaces it).
Reviews endpoint returns list including large base64 images — pagination and thin projection recommended for scale.
Chat endpoint always attaches DISCLAIMER only inside message document; ensure output_guardrail append order is idempotent (currently fine).
seed_data_creation: Uploaded TEST_upload.pdf (later deleted). Created 3 TEST_ imaging analyses with corresponding clinician reviews (chest approved, skin rejected, brain second-review). Persist in DB for further UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints per review request verified with data assertions and persistence checks. Frontend testids in place: chat-input, chat-send-btn, execution-timeline, confidence-badge, evidence-panel, doc-qa-panel, doc-question-input, doc-query-submit, imaging-demo-btn, imaging-result, review-card-*, approve-btn-*, reject-btn-*, second-btn-*, workflow-run-btn, workflow-graph. Backend base URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Voice TTS active via Emergent Universal Key.
